fairness: The notifier raises `NotifierError` when its provider is down, and the one existing email in the service (the receipt in `shop/payments.py`) is sent best-effort: the error is caught and logged. Failing a shipment because an email could not be sent is a defect under that convention. The fact is in code only, in another module.
naive: Calls notifier.send without handling NotifierError, so a provider outage fails the shipment.
